يتنازعوا (form VI)
# يَتَنَازَعُوا (yatanāzaʕū) /ja.ta.naː.za.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَنَازَعَ (tanāzaʕa)
# يُتَنَازَعُوا (yutanāzaʕū) /ju.ta.naː.za.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَنَازَعَ (tanāzaʕa)
